data.summary: Whenever a **Charge move** is made by this model, its melee weapons gain **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** until the turn ends. Also, once per battle, it may **Advance** and still declare a charge that turn.
